incidents.name: Defrost LSWUSDC reentrancy
incidents.notes: The Defrost LSWUSDC vault released the underlying USDC before updating the caller's share accounting, so re-entering the withdrawal from the token callback let one deposit be redeemed repeatedly until the vault's USDC was gone.

sources.ref: onchain review: LSWUSDC 0xfF152e21C5A511c478ED23D1b89Bb9391bE6de96 created 2022-09-13T02:51:58Z by 0x3cd5854fe3a13707b7882d8290d3cae793a7751a, not the attack-tx sender 0x7373dca267bdc623dfba228696c9d4e8234469f6; no EIP-1967 events, 101.4 days old. Summing the ERC-20 Transfer logs of the exploit receipt gives a net +173,637.63 USDC to the attack contract 0x792e8f3727cad6e00c58d478798f0907c4cec340, which matches the ~$170k figure in the DeFiHackLabs 2022 index; USDC taken at 1:1.
